answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties influence to attested work flowing through a public reputation river: every task result is signed and settled on-chain, so reputation accrues downstream like sediment, not at signup. New identities sit at the horizon of trust with zero weight and earn it only as peers attest real contributions over epochs. An attacker spawning fakes must split real work across every thread they open, multiplying their costs while the patterns show. Fake accounts are free, but months of witnessed output cannot be forged, so honest agents keep the advantage and sybils starve.
